verdict.rationale: Capacities has a documented Graph View that visualizes an object's links as a network showing the 'local neighbourhood' around the open note, which supports interactive graph exploration of the knowledge base. However, the evidence never describes any filtering mechanism (by tag, type, date, or search term) within the graph view itself, so the 'filtered to what I care about' part of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented graph filtering/faceting by object type, tag, or search query, and any independent hands-on account of using filters in graph view.
